text: ShuttleboxR provides structured workflow moving raw shuttle-box recordings checked, interpretable dataset ready statistical analysis. package organised around three consecutive tasks: Import organise raw data. Calculate shuttle-box metrics using consistent definitions. Inspect troubleshoot data formal analysis. logic applied two complementary levels: single-trial branch, used calculate inspect results one fish; project branch, used fish processed compare metrics across study flag unusual trials closer inspection. ShuttleboxR supports quality control data exploration. automatically decide fish excluded, replace statistical analysis appropriate study. trial appears unusual project level checked raw temperature, tracking behavioural records, interpreted context species experimental design.
code: Raw shuttle-box recordings         |         +-- Single-trial branch         |      1. Import and organise one trial         |      2. Calculate thermal and behavioural metrics         |      3. Inspect system performance and fish behaviour         |         +-- Project branch                1. Import all trials or an existing results database                2. Compile one row of metrics per fish                3. Inspect distributions, relationships and multivariate patterns                               |                               v                     Flag trials for review                               |                               v                     Return to the single-trial plots

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9007
text: Fixed vignette-building failures project-level screening plots. Quantile values now stored without inherited percentile names, cutoff lookups lower_limit_high, distance_low, shuttles_high work correctly. Applied correction plot_upper_vs_lower_extremes(), plot_distance_vs_shuttles(), plot_limits_vs_distance(), plot_limits_vs_shuttles().

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9006
text: Replaced original bin-diversity definition Tbreadth mean absolute difference pairs observed core temperatures (Gini mean difference). calc_Tbreadth() now accounts actual distance occupied temperatures, use histogram bins, centred Tpref. Updated plot_coreT_histogram() bin width affects visual histogram; displayed Tbreadth calculated original observations. Tpref line now shows median core temperature. Rewrote README, vignette, examples help pages plain-language worked explanations, including 50% 10 degrees Celsius / 50% 20 degrees Celsius example. Removed obsolete Tbreadth_bin_size argument calc_project_results().

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9004
text: Reframed README, vignette, package overview website reference index around package’s three-stage workflow: import organise, calculate metrics, inspect troubleshoot. Clarified two connected branches individual trials complete projects, including recommended loop project-level screening back detailed single-trial inspection. Expanded explanation quality control: project-level outlier screens flag candidates review provide automatic basis excluding fish. Added metric overview integrated Tbreadth complementary measure percentile-based Tpref_range. Clarified ShuttleboxR prepares explores data formal statistical analysis rather selecting inferential analysis .

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9003
text: Added bundled 85-trial project-results database complete project-level analysis section vignette. Added read_project_database() import existing summary databases standardise column names used older ShuttleboxR versions. Updated project-level scatter plots correlation analysis work directly current legacy project-result column names return plot correlation objects. Repaired strengthened pca(), including input checks, missing-data handling, outlier reporting, reusable plot outputs.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9002
text: Added complete getting-started vignette included example ShuttleSoft file. Added structured pkgdown reference index automated documentation website workflow. Expanded README added simple package-maintenance guide. read_shuttlesoft() read_shuttlesoft_project() now accept tab-delimited .txt files comma-separated .csv exports. plot_coreT_histogram() now reports effective selected thermal breadth, uses bin boundaries consistent calc_Tbreadth(), returns plot object invisibly.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9001
text: Added calc_Tbreadth() effective selected thermal breadth based frequency distribution core_T. Made metadata optional importing single ShuttleSoft file. Added direct trial_start, mass, initial_T, a_value, b_value arguments read_shuttlesoft(). read_shuttlesoft() now prepares imported files default. Made file_prepare() robust trial start time supplied. Added direct thermal-model arguments calc_coreT() clarified a_value b_value require external calibration. Made metadata optional read_shuttlesoft_project(). Added Tbreadth calc_project_results() made recalculation core_T optional rather automatic.
